subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

They probably subsisted on insects and other small _______ invertebrates and perhaps even on aquatic vertebrates.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Terrestrial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Terrestrial **means relating to the earth or land. (पृथ्वी या भूमि से संबंधित)
 
• The sentence suggests that the creatures in question ate insects and small invertebrates that were found on land.
 
• Therefore, "**terrestrial**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
